Welcome to our bright and spacious 120 m² family home located in the Reykjavík capital area. Large north-facing windows offer beautiful ocean views and stunning sunsets, while the private south-facing garden features a sheltered terrace with comfortable outdoor seating and a fireplace.

The home is just a stone’s throw from the shoreline, lava fields, and scenic outdoor walking paths, while downtown Reykjavík is only a 20-minute drive away.

Guest access
Guests have private access to the spacious upper floor of the home, including all living areas, kitchen, bathroom, and terrace. The main entrance is shared with the lower floor.

Rating, 5 stars

Berglind is a very friendly host and always willing to share tips of things to do and see. The house is located in a quiet neighbourhood and you have a view on old lavafields, the bay and on Reykjavik. Within a 15 minutes drive you are in the shopping area of Reykjavik and supermarkets are within 6 minutes. The house is pleasant and spacious (we are a family of four with two kids of 20 and 18). We could also use the garden to sit outside. The location is very suitable to go on roadtrips like the Golden Circle or Dyrholaey (see puffins!). We enjoyed our week long stay very much.
